text:
Jordan Lee: quick Q from CSM side re: Usage Insights — for QBRs we need something we can *share* w/ the customer + internally. Ideally a PDF report (top routes/models + what changed WoW) we can drop into decks. Is PDF in scope for beta or are we doing CSV only?

Marissa Cole: we have “shareable reports” in the PRD language but current build is export CSV + shareable link to the view (RBAC gated). PDF hasn’t been designed/committed yet.

Jordan Lee: got it. the link helps, but for QBRs the audience is often exec + finance, they don’t always have console access. PDF is the easiest artifact.

Markus Klein: +1 from SE calls. HelioChat literally asked “can you send me a weekly PDF” so they can forward to finance.

Paula Mendes: we scoped scheduled email reports + “pretty report generator” as follow-up. For beta we were trying to keep to: route/model breakdown + top drivers + CSV export + shareable link.

Dylan Brooks: from eng perspective, PDF export is a different project (rendering, layout, charts, localization, etc). CSV is straightforward and already in ENG-3816. We can also do “download screenshot” later but that’s still UX work.

Jordan Lee: understood. is there a near-term workaround we can tell CSMs? (ex: generate a static report via link -> screenshot, or a templated spreadsheet?)

Elliot Price: docs can include a QBR workflow section: “Export CSV -> pivot -> copy into slides”. We can ship a basic Google Sheets template and instructions. Not as nice as PDF but at least repeatable.

Rishi Malhotra: finance POV: CSV is actually better for reconciliation + rollups, but I agree QBR wants something presentation-ready. If we can add a “summary” row + consistent column naming, that helps a lot.

Marissa Cole: maybe we frame it as:
- Beta: CSV export + shareable link (RBAC)
- GA+1: PDF/print-friendly report
We should be explicit in release notes so CSM isn’t promising PDF.

Connor O'Brien: +1 please. we’ve already had a few “can we get a PDF?” asks in rollout checklist. Better to set expectation now.

Jordan Lee: ok. for shareable link — is it a “public” link or only within workspace users?

Dylan Brooks: only within workspace + permissioned roles. No public links. Security review was pretty clear: cost data can’t be shared outside account context, and link access must enforce RBAC.

Paula Mendes: also audit logging for exports + share link access events is in scope. but again, inside the org boundary.

Jordan Lee: that means it won’t solve “exec who doesn’t have access” cases. (common for QBR decks where attendees aren’t provisioned)

Marissa Cole: yep. that’s why PDF comes up. but we’d still need a policy call on whether PDF download is effectively “export” (it is) and would need the same controls/audit.

Rishi Malhotra: if we do PDF later, please treat it as an export artifact (same permission + audit event as CSV). Otherwise we’ll re-open all the compliance conversations.

Markus Klein: what’s the earliest realistic timing for PDF if we decide to add it?

Dylan Brooks: not in beta window. If we did a print-friendly view (CSS + simplified layout) maybe 1–2 sprints, but a true “generated report PDF w/ charts” is more like a mini product.

Elliot Price: could we do a “print this page” guidance + ensure the page renders decently when printing to PDF? That might be a pragmatic middle ground.

Marissa Cole: that’s interesting. “Print-friendly” could be a GA nicety without building a separate pipeline.

Jordan Lee: that would help a lot for QBRs. even if it’s not perfect.

Paula Mendes: action: I’ll add a follow-up ticket proposal: “print-friendly usage insights view” (not promising) and we’ll align w/ security on whether it’s just client-side print vs a server-side PDF.

Connor O'Brien: please also add this to beta enablement notes so AEs/CSMs have consistent talk track.

Marissa Cole: yep. Jordan can you share 1-2 examples of what you’d want in a QBR “report” so design has something concrete? (sections, screenshots, etc.)

Jordan Lee: will do. I’ll grab notes from HelioChat QBR + Northstar ask and post here.

Markus Klein: I’ll DM you the snippet from the sales call where they asked for weekly PDFs.

Elliot Price: once we settle on beta messaging, I’ll update the help center draft w/ a “QBR workflow” section + link to the CSV template.

Jordan Lee: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:

Marissa Cole: thanks — for now we’ll keep beta messaging as CSV export + shareable link (RBAC). No PDF promise. We'll revisit post-beta.

Connor O'Brien: noted. I’ll make sure release notes call out “exports are CSV only” + “share links require console access.”
